{{Quote|Illafian Point is fine. It’s beautiful here. And I doubt you could find a place that was any less like Imperial City.|Leia Organa Solo|<ref name="SOL"/>}}
'''Illafian Point''' was a [[City/Legends|settlement]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rathalay]] located on its western sea's western shore. The city's beaches drew few visitors to enjoy its [[Color/Legends|grey]] [[Basalt/Legends|basalt]] sands and expansive oceans;<ref name="SOL"/> they were often deserted.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|83|Illafian Point}}</ref> In the surf, shiny [[seamote]]s populated the beaches and whose shells some visitors collected. Not far off the shoreline but 900 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] below the surface, the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Just Cause]]'' sat rusting, with its rumored treasure guarded by a school of vicious [[narkaa]].<ref name="SOL"/>

In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]],<ref name="VacayDate">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' dated the events of the [[Solo family/Legends|Solo family]] vacation to twelve years after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dated [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], therefore it occurred during [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]].</ref> while on her [[Solo family/Legends|family]] vacation to the quiet locale, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] noted its natural beauty and calm unlike the [[Imperial City]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="SOL"/>

==Behind the scenes==
Illafian Point appeared in the [[1996]] novel ''[[Shield of Lies]]'', written by [[Michael P. Kube-McDowell]].<ref name="SOL"/>
